subject: Q3 leadership slate: path to sign-off and comp clarifications
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Cassidy Muller <cassidy@talentpartners.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 leadership slate: path to sign-off and comp clarifications

Team — attaching the recommended Q3 leadership slate for your review (Q3_Leadership_Slate_v2.xlsx) and the proposed comp bands document (Compensation_Bands_Q3_v1.pdf). Highlights up front:
- Slate includes two VP-level hires (Platform Eng, Ops) and one Director->VP internal uplift for Product.
- Net incremental HC: +2.5 FTE (one replacement counted at 0.5) — fits within budget envelope with the revised ramp assumptions.
- Compensation bands updated to reflect mid‑year market movement; small adjustments in VP target 50th/75th lines.

Asks: Vivek — can you confirm whether you are OK with CEO-level signoff (I can route the final memo to you for signature), or do you want this escalated to the board liaisons?
Lauren — we need final confirmation on salary ranges for the two external VP offers before we extend. Can you confirm if total OTE ranges include the revised equity bands (attached)?
Aditya — please confirm runway math (tab 'BudgetImpact' in the spreadsheet) matches your latest forecast; I flagged one conservative hiring timing assumption (VP Ops start set to 9/1).
Marcus — quick note: the Platform VP is a backfill for an early departure; we recommend hiring at the mid-to-upper quartile to reduce time-to-accept. Your thoughts on market urgency?

Next steps: if I get signoff today I will prepare the CEO memo and a one-page summary for the board packet. I also copied Cassidy from Talent Partners — she's primed to accelerate candidate outreach once bands approved.

Attachments: Q3_Leadership_Slate_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), Compensation_Bands_Q3_v1.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — Ava
Ava Chen
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 leadership slate: path to sign-off and comp clarifications

Thanks Ava — quick read. Two quick items: 1) I prefer CEO signoff on the slate (I will sign) unless there's material budget movement; 2) for the Platform VP I want us to be deliberate on leveling — if this is mission-critical infrastructure, push toward a stronger candidate even if we pay up.

Aditya — if budget impact is within the numbers Ava ran, I am OK to sign today. If not, escalate to me with the delta.

Vivek

Subject: Re: Q3 leadership slate: path to sign-off and comp clarifications

Ava — reviewed the attached comp band doc and made inline notes (see Comp_Bands_Q3_comments.pdf). Two clarifications: 
1) VP salary targets in the spreadsheet should show base + target bonus + target equity (we currently present OTE but not broken out). I flagged the Platform VP as \"Market 75th\" — recommend total OTE of $315k-$365k depending on experience.
2) Equity: for external VP offers we should plan 0.35%–0.6% depending on level; include acceleration language only for exceptional candidates.

I will push the updated bands and a one-page offer guidance doc by EOD so Cassidy has a working packet to share with candidates.

Lauren
HRBP — Executive Recruiting
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 15:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 leadership slate: path to sign-off and comp clarifications

Folks — ran the BudgetImpact tab with the latest run-rate assumptions. Summary: the slate as proposed (VP Platform + VP Ops + internal uplift) increases FY28 spend by ~2.1% relative to the baseline, and keeps cash runway unchanged to within 0.2 months under current ARR growth forecast. The critical path item is start date for VP Ops — moving it from 9/1 to 8/1 increases near-term burn by $120k but keeps long-term value.

If Vivek is comfortable signing, I am comfortable routing the CEO memo. No need to escalate to the board for this incremental impact.

Attached: BudgetImpact_snapshot.csv (snapshot exported from model).

Aditya
COO
Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 2 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 leadership slate: path to sign-off and comp clarifications

Appreciate the careful framing. Quick operational asks from my side: 
- For Platform VP (time-to-hire = critical), please give Cassidy a target slate of 6–8 profiles and permission to offer market-top salary where justified.
- For Ops VP (customer-facing and supporting AcmeHealth rollout), Jo Ramos from AcmeHealth flagged timeline sensitivity — earlier start preferred. If we accelerate to 8/1 we should ensure a $40k temporary hiring budget buffer to support relocation/bonus.

If Vivek is comfortable signing, I ask we include a one-paragraph customer impact justification in the CEO memo (I can draft).

Marcus
SVP, GTM
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — I have reviewed the updated notes and budget snapshot. Ava, please proceed:
1) Prepare CEO signoff memo using the template (include Marcus's customer impact paragraph).
2) Finalize comp bands per Lauren's guidance and confirm OTE breakdowns in the memo.
3) Authorize Cassidy to prioritize Platform VP with permission to extend to the top of the range where justified; approve a one-off $40k buffer for Ops VP relocation/bonus if we accelerate start to 8/1.

Send me the memo for signature and I will sign before Monday EOD. Good work getting this to a clean decision.

Vivek
CEO, Redwood Inference
